hardGateRule.description: Physical packaging (washer + dryer in one cabinet) is not sufficient for new canonical graph.
tree: Existing frozen family? → compare functional contract
Can it satisfy existing functional contract? → YES → prove variant → no canonical mutation
NO → document functional divergence → triangulate → only then authorize discovery
hardGateRule.disallowedShortcut: Creating aio_laundry_combo.json because the appliance performs wash and dry without fit/falsification closure
hardGateRule.heatPumpVentlessGuard: Do not inherit AIO drying architecture from vented_dryer merely because both perform drying. Evaluate whether vented_dryer models moisture rejection, heat generation, and airflow functional relationships — not only the word dryer.

frozenContractsUnderTest.note: Evaluate whether AIO wash path maps without mutating FL washer contract
Evaluate dry path — especially heat-pump / condenser / ventless architectures vs heated_airflow_path + exhaust_path
Evaluate only where relevant — do not force AIO onto TL family because it is laundry

fitTestVocabulary.rule: Fit-test vocabulary only — do not auto-promote to canonical concepts

centerpieceQuestions.question: Can the AIO washing portion be represented by front_load_washer without canonical mutation?
centerpieceQuestions.framing: Functional responsibilities (fill, drain, tumble, door lock, level sense, wash heat) — not cabinet shape alone.

centerpieceQuestions.question: Can the AIO drying portion be represented by vented_dryer without canonical mutation?
centerpieceQuestions.framing: Critical: heat-pump / condenser / ventless moisture rejection vs vented_dryer heated_airflow_path requiring exhaust_path.

centerpieceQuestions.question: Is AIO a composed implementation of existing frozen domains, or does integration introduce functional relationships neither family represents?
centerpieceQuestions.framing: If wash fits FL and dry fits vented, document composed variant — do not invent AIO ontology. If dry does not fit vented, composed hypothesis fails.

centerpieceQuestions.question: Are compressor, condenser loop, dehumidifying kit, auto-open door, and foam-in-dehumidification merely implementation detail — or functional divergence?
centerpieceQuestions.framing: Component novelty ≠ functional novelty; but different moisture-rejection and heat-generation contracts may still diverge.
